cases.brief: A validated short-film story/script package and scene-full scene package describe a night custodian in one building. The selected mode is live-action-only; no inspectable generated media or measurable media metadata is supplied.
observables: Uses the exact live-action-only inventory: production design, character look, VFX, media review, and manifest; creates neither animation plan nor media-prompt package.
Validates the upstream story/script and scene packages before orchestration, preserves valid unaffected specialist records, and stops at the earliest invalid dependency if a prerequisite fails.
Returns awaiting-media rather than approving unseen media, then requires the current validate-production hard gate before ready-for-post.

cases.brief: A validated short-form story/script package and scene-full scene package require an AI-only production package. Prompt sources are supplied, but no generated output, preview, waveform, or measurable metadata is accessible.
observables: Uses the exact ai-only inventory: production design, character look, VFX, media-prompt package, media review, and manifest; creates no animation plan.
Keeps prompt content and specialist semantics source-bound, preserves valid unaffected records, and does not invent media inspection or approval from prompt text or filenames.
Reports awaiting-media until applicable evidence exists; unresolved blockers return blocked, and ready-for-post requires a current successful validate-production result.

cases.brief: A hybrid production package has valid design and character look artifacts, but the animation plan names an invalid shot and the media review later has a blocker.
observables: Finds the animation plan as the earliest invalid dependency after confirming its upstream artifacts, preserves valid unaffected design and character look records, and invalidates only the transitive downstream closure.
Keeps the exact hybrid inventory, refreshes the manifest and validation evidence after repair, and returns blocked while the media blocker remains unresolved.
Never substitutes a prior validation result or a manifest claim for the required validate-production hard gate.
